subject: Air freight quote: FRA to DOH
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well! Our buyer in Doha, QA, is importing some precision instruments from us in Germany, and I’m arranging the flight for their import shipment.

We’ll deliver the goods to Frankfurt airport (FRA) ourselves, so there’s no pickup needed. The shipment will be ready on 2026-11-28 and consists of 6 pieces, with a gross weight of 102 kg and a total volume of 0.49 cbm.

Could you send me an all-in price in EUR for the cheapest air freight option from FRA to DOH for this import?

Thanks for your help!

Thanks a lot and have a lovely day!
Petra Hofmann
Export Desk, Hofmann Textilwerk KG
